mod.name: Arma Commander Actual
mod.summary: An unofficial port of the classic Arma 3 mod Arma Commander to Arma Reforger: a hybrid RTS/FPS where a commander orders squads on the map and seamlessly takes over any soldier or gunner on the ground.
mod.description:
# Arma Commander: Actual

Plan the attack. Call in support. Then grab a rifle and see how your plan survives contact.

Command squads from the map, take over a friendly soldier and fight alongside them. Capture territory across Arland, Everon and Kolguyev, solo against AI commanders or sharing command with friends. An unofficial, openly vibecoded Reforger port of Arma 3's Arma Commander.

Requires the separate Better Battle Buddies (BBB) addon. Vanilla sides need no faction mods.

## In 0.5.6: take the fight forward

- Build a FOB with a construction truck, 500 supplies and a squad on site for 90 seconds. Develop eight upgrade spots for medical care, maintenance, ammunition, fuel, helicopters, communications, barracks and storage.
- Fortify the perimeter with sandbags, machine-gun nests, then bunkers and guard towers. Barracks provide defenders and perimeter patrols.
- Keep it supplied: order deliveries, expand storage and maintain a friendly radio relay for deployment and reinforcement. Upgrades spend local supplies and pause under contest.
- Raid enemy headquarters with demolition charges, disarm a sapper's charge before it fires, or capture the surviving buildings. A lost headquarters shuts the FOB down; rebuild it with Establish FOB.
- Face AI commanders that build and supply forward bases, coordinate attacks from several approaches, hold supporting fire in overwatch and defend in depth.

## Command and fight

- Shared command map with squad status, enemy sightings and radio reports.
- Move, defend, hunt, queue waypoints and garrison buildings. Possess a soldier whenever you want to join the action.
- Capture bases for RP; buy infantry, vehicles, mortar crews and observers.
- Call artillery, combat helicopters and off-map squad air lifts.
- BBB adds combat, medical and vehicle behaviour. Player orders and ACA's command rules take priority over autonomous features.

## Pick your battlefield

Choose an AC: Actual scenario in Scenarios or Host. Before Start, the host/admin sets sides, layout, threat, prices, commanders, unit caps, starting RP, income and logistics. Joiners wait for the host; no external launcher is needed.

Everon includes a hand-built island layout, halves and flashpoints. Generated layouts place bases and HQs around named locations: preview, reroll the seed or move bases before Start. Kolguyev uses generated layouts. Other terrains need an AC: Actual scenario setup.

On generated layouts, build a helipad before buying helicopters; off-map air lift needs no pad. There are no victory conditions or saved matches. Owned bases automatically report enemies within their radius plus 60 m, without requiring line of sight.

## Mission makers: make it your battlefield

Start from a shipped scenario, choose hand-placed bases or a generated layout, and tune factions, requisitions, supports and logistics in Workbench. Keep your scenario in its own addon with AC: Actual as a dependency.

Setup, settings, testing and sharing guide:
https://github.com/propst-design/ArmaCommanderReforger/blob/main/MISSION-MAKING.md

## Controls

- M / F9: command map. Left-click a squad, right-click a destination.
- F7: possess a friendly soldier under the crosshair or map cursor.
- F8: return to your command unit.
- F6 in a vehicle: dismount passengers; repeat within three seconds to override warnings.
- W/A/S/D in a turret with an AI driver: gunner drive.
- Backtick while possessing a squad leader: native squad orders.

Rebind keys in Settings > Controls > AC: Actual. Tested on PC; console/controller play is unverified.

## Factions and compatibility

Shipped maps offer US, USSR and FIA. Optional RHS US/Russia and Ukraine Armed Forces RHS have fitted faction entries. Joiners need the server's mod set. Other factions need map entries and GM catalogs; expect mixed kit or fallbacks. ACE All in One and the optional AiO Command Menu have been used in development.

## Feedback, credits and licence

Discord: https://discord.gg/WK8xGSztB
Use #issues for AC: Actual bugs and #suggestions for ideas or factions. No GitHub account needed.
GitHub alternative: https://github.com/propst-design/ArmaCommanderReforger/issues
Include map, versions, mods, reproduction steps and affected logs.

Original Arma Commander: Martin Hájek. Community fork: Anarch Cassius, Ilyushkius and Will. Reforger port directed, designed and play-tested by Jacob (propst-design). Nearly all code and documentation by Claude (Anthropic), with code/test contributions from Codex (OpenAI) and contributions from Antigravity (Google). Playtesters: PoppiPoppins, Hexxyz and Frost.

Arma Public License Share Alike (APL-SA); see LICENSE.md. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Bohemia Interactive or the original authors.
